clue.text: Two bishops entertained by a reverend, represented as such

indicators.note: a guest entertained by hosts sits within their home, so these letters go inside the others

blocks.note: taken as written
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop, doubled
the usual short form of reverend

explanation.surface: A pair of bishops are hosted by a vicar, who then describes them in some fashion.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is self-referential: ABBREV is itself a shortened word, so it is 'represented as such', that is, abbreviated.
explanation.definitionFit: ABBREV is the clipped form of abbreviation, so the word is literally presented in the shortened state it names.

clue.text: Foot it after main vessel about to go north

indicators.note: in a down entry, going north means reading upwards, so this group of letters is turned round

blocks.note: the main is a poetic name for the open ocean
a pan is a cooking vessel
A is a short form of about, as in the Latin ante or circa senses Chambers allows
T for 'it', the very thing, as in 'to a T'

explanation.surface: An instruction to walk off after a large ship heads north.
explanation.walkthrough: Only the main vessel about is reversed; 'it' then follows. 'Foot it' reads as 'walk', but Foot alone is the definition, a metrical foot.
explanation.definitionFit: An anapaest is a metrical foot of two short syllables followed by one long, so it is a unit of verse rhythm.

clue.text: Bear up at first after party's made a U-turn

indicators.note: turning round to head back the way it came means this word is read backwards
at first points to the opening letter of the word before it

blocks.note: Lab is short for the Labour Party
the first letter of up

explanation.surface: A bear rises up after its political party performs a sudden reversal of policy.
explanation.walkthrough: The bear's letter comes after the party's reversed letters even though the clue mentions it first; 'after' gives the order.
explanation.definitionFit: Balu is the Indian name for the sloth bear, the animal behind Kipling's Baloo.

clue.text: Sounds of "give way" and "go away"? It helps to stop the car

definitions.text: It helps to stop the car

indicators.note: sounds of tells us we want words that are said like the quoted phrases rather than spelt like them

blocks.note: to break is to give way under strain
shoo is what you say to drive something away

explanation.surface: Road signs saying give way and go away, both useful for halting a motorist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Give way' looks like a traffic sign in this motoring surface, but it means break, collapse.
explanation.definitionFit: A brake shoe is the curved part that presses against a drum to slow a vehicle's wheel.

clue.text: Rogue sent outside convoy empty — put in Shell?

definitions.note: past participle sense; ENCYST is the verb, 'put in shell' read as an imperative verb phrase

indicators.note: a rogue goes astray from good order, so these letters are rearranged
one set of letters is placed outside, around the other
emptying a word takes out its middle and leaves only its outer letters

blocks.note: taken as written, to be rearranged
the first and last letters of convoy

explanation.surface: A rogue was sent round an empty convoy, perhaps to be put in a Shell garage.
explanation.walkthrough: Shell is capitalised to suggest the oil company; here it is a plain shell, a capsule.
explanation.definitionFit: To encyst is to enclose in a cyst or protective capsule, as some organisms do to survive.

clue.text: Oddly sole meunière grilled becomes rather unattractive

indicators.note: oddly keeps the letters in the odd-numbered positions of the next word
grilling cooks and changes the fish, so the letters come out in a new order

blocks.note: first and third letters of sole
taken as written, accent dropped

explanation.surface: A sole meunière that is grilled instead of fried looks rather less appealing.
explanation.walkthrough: Sole meunière is fish dredged in flour and fried in butter; grilling it is the culinary sin in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Unseemly means unbecoming or improper in appearance, so its comparative is rather more unattractive.

clue.text: Backing needed, if and when county is a failure

indicators.note: backing means going in reverse, so the short word after it is read backwards

blocks.note: taken as written, then turned round
as in 'as he arrived' means when he arrived
Co. is the usual abbreviation for county

explanation.surface: Support is needed if and when the county fails, like a struggling cricket side.
explanation.definitionFit: A fiasco is a complete and humiliating failure, a synonym for a total flop.

clue.text: French department to be ready when power cut off

indicators.note: cutting something off removes it, so this letter is taken out

blocks.note: to poise is to hold in readiness or balance
P is the physics symbol for power

explanation.surface: A French region gets ready while suffering a power cut.
explanation.definitionFit: The Oise is a département of northern France, named after the river running through it.

clue.text: Look at silk handkerchief, head dropping

indicators.note: dropping the head means the opening letter is lost

blocks.note: fogle is old thieves' slang for a silk handkerchief

explanation.surface: Someone eyes a silk handkerchief while their head droops.
explanation.walkthrough: Fogle is an old slang word, found in Dickens, for a silk pocket handkerchief.
explanation.definitionFit: To ogle is to look at someone with obvious desire, a leering form of staring.

clue.text: Small whisky in pot and a Bulgarian's ready

indicators.note: in places one word inside another

blocks.note: to sink a ball is to pot it, as in snooker
a tot is a small measure of spirits
taken as written

explanation.surface: A Bulgarian has a small whisky in a pot at the ready.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Small' tempts as S, but 'Small whisky' is one unit; ready is slang for cash, so the definition is Bulgarian money.
explanation.definitionFit: The stotinka is the Bulgarian coin worth one hundredth of a lev, so it is a piece of that country's cash.

clue.text: Spot opening for estate agent

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter

blocks.note: the first letter of estate
a secret agent is a spy

explanation.surface: An estate agent spots an opening, a property for sale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Estate agent' reads as one profession, but the two words split: the first gives a letter, the second is a spy.
explanation.definitionFit: To espy is to catch sight of, which is one sense of the verb to spot.

clue.text: School hunting shark on vacation takes "Sir" away

indicators.note: to school is to train or drill, reshaping these letters into order
a vacated word has been emptied, leaving only its outside letters

blocks.note: taken as written
the first and last letters of shark

explanation.surface: A school out hunting a shark during the holidays strips someone of a knighthood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'School' seems a noun, a school of fish or pupils, but it is a verb meaning train.
explanation.definitionFit: To unknight someone is to deprive them of a knighthood, removing their right to the title Sir.

clue.text: One amateur after another put down as before

indicators.note: one after another means things set down in sequence, so the pieces follow each other

blocks.note: a means one
lay means non-professional, as in a layman

explanation.surface: One amateur after another is dismissed, as happened in the past.
explanation.walkthrough: 'As before' marks an obsolete word: ALAY is an old spelling of allay.
explanation.definitionFit: To allay is to quell or suppress, and ALAY is its archaic spelling, so it means put down in the old style.

clue.text: Camper in cell first

indicators.note: first says which piece comes at the front of the sequence

blocks.note: a cell phone is a mobile
to be in is to be at home

explanation.surface: A camper is locked in a prison cell first.
explanation.walkthrough: The words read in the order 'in cell', but 'first' puts the phone ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: A camper is a vehicle with living quarters, the same kind of dwelling on wheels as a caravan.

clue.text: Kitty for instance, returned for a hot drink

indicators.note: returned means sent back, so the combined letters are read in the opposite direction

blocks.note: a kitty is a shared pool of money
as in 'cities, as London' means for instance

explanation.surface: A cat, say, comes home for a warm drink.
explanation.walkthrough: Kitty is capitalised to look like a cat or a name; it is a pot of money.
explanation.definitionFit: Saloop was a hot drink of sassafras or salep sold on London streets in the eighteenth century.

clue.text: Tiny tot regularly absorbed by small guitar in Japanese school

indicators.note: regularly means at even intervals, taking every other letter
something absorbed is taken inside, so these letters go within the other word

blocks.note: uke is short for ukulele, a small guitar
second, fourth and sixth letters of tiny tot

explanation.surface: A toddler is engrossed in a ukulele at a Japanese school.
explanation.definitionFit: Ukiyo-e is the Japanese school of woodblock prints depicting everyday life, so it is an artistic movement.

clue.text: Real friend is in for lots of criticism

blocks.note: a brick is an old-fashioned word for a loyal, reliable friend
in cricket the side that is in bats

explanation.surface: A true friend steps in to take a lot of flak on someone's behalf.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the team that 'is in' is batting.
explanation.definitionFit: Brickbats are harsh remarks; the plural word stands for a barrage of disparaging comment.

clue.text: Hittable balls not all put over third man

indicators.note: not all of the words are used, only a run of letters sitting inside them
putting something over turns it the other way, so the letters read backwards

blocks.note: the run of letters spanning the end of the first word and start of the second

explanation.surface: Not every easy delivery gets hit past the fielder at third man in cricket.
explanation.walkthrough: Third man is a cricket fielding position behind the batsman on the off side; here it means the third human being.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis, Abel, son of Adam and Eve, was the third person created after his parents.

clue.text: Strike-breaker in Welsh town stirring up quarrels

indicators.note: in places one word inside another

blocks.note: Barry is a coastal town in south Wales
a rat is a worker who breaks a strike

explanation.surface: A strike-breaker in a Welsh town provokes disputes.
explanation.definitionFit: Barratry is the legal offence of persistently inciting lawsuits or quarrels, a form of vexatious litigation.

clue.text: English and French physicist in sporting team

blocks.note: E is the abbreviation for English
Pierre or Marie Curie, French physicists

explanation.surface: An English and a French scientist join a sports team together.
explanation.definitionFit: An écurie is a stable of racing cars and drivers, a motor-racing team.

clue.text: Colonnades in European designs

blocks.note: EU, the European Union
styles are designs or fashions

explanation.surface: Rows of columns built in a continental style.
explanation.definitionFit: A eustyle is a colonnade with columns spaced at the classically ideal interval of two and a quarter diameters.

clue.text: Most irate about Asian country

indicators.note: about suggests being turned around and rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone is furious about a south-east Asian nation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About' reads as 'concerning', but it shuffles the first two words.
explanation.definitionFit: East Timor, or Timor-Leste, is an independent nation in south-east Asia.

clue.text: Starts taking drink in casual clothing

indicators.note: taking means holding something within, so one word goes inside another

blocks.note: a film or engine rolls when it starts
to neck a drink is to gulp it down

explanation.surface: Someone begins drinking while dressed casually.
explanation.definitionFit: Roll-necks are jumpers with a high turned-over collar, typical informal wear.

clue.text: Criminal heard supporting love and goodness

indicators.note: criminal means crooked, so the letters are bent out of order
in a down entry, supporting means sitting underneath, so this part comes second

blocks.note: love is zero in tennis, shaped like O
taken as written

explanation.surface: A crook was overheard backing love and virtue.
explanation.walkthrough: Goodness here is the exclamation, as in 'my goodness!', not virtue.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are mild exclamations of dismay or surprise, interchangeable as interjections.

clue.text: Least likely to upset possible clients with no end of mail

indicators.note: possible suggests one of several arrangements, so the letters are reordered
with no means lacking, so a letter is removed
the end of a word is its last letter

blocks.note: taken as written
the last letter of mail

explanation.surface: Advice on keeping potential customers sweet when the post has run out.
explanation.definitionFit: The nicest person is the most agreeable, so the least likely to cause offence.

clue.text: Tablet and other computers initially buggy

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of the word before it
something buggy is faulty, so the letters are in a broken order

blocks.note: taken as written
the first letter of computers

explanation.surface: A tablet computer and other devices are full of software glitches from the start.
explanation.walkthrough: Tablet suggests a computer in this surface; it is a medicinal lozenge.
explanation.definitionFit: A troche is a small medicated lozenge dissolved in the mouth, a kind of pill.

clue.text: Oriental material made from lynx, not kangaroo

indicators.note: not means without, so this animal's letters are removed

blocks.note: rooikat is the South African name for the caracal, a lynx
roo is the short form of kangaroo

explanation.surface: An Eastern fabric is made from lynx fur but not kangaroo hide.
explanation.walkthrough: The rooikat, Afrikaans for 'red cat', is the caracal or desert lynx.
explanation.definitionFit: Ikat is a South-East Asian textile whose threads are tie-dyed before weaving, an Eastern fabric.

clue.text: Book person from northern Europe

blocks.note: first meaning: the abbreviation for the Book of Esther
second meaning: an Estonian, in an old term

explanation.surface: A book about a northern European.
explanation.definitionFit: Esth. abbreviates the biblical Book of Esther, and Esth is also an archaic word for a native of Estonia.

clue.text: Old ship's slow passage long forgotten

indicators.note: something forgotten is left out, so this letter is dropped

blocks.note: largo is a musical movement played slowly
L is the abbreviation for long

explanation.surface: An ancient ship's sluggish voyage has long been forgotten.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Passage' suggests a voyage beside 'ship'; it is a passage of music.
explanation.definitionFit: The Argo was the legendary ship of Jason and the Argonauts in Greek myth.

clue.text: Man on Caribbean island is famous royal spouse

indicators.note: in an across entry, one thing on another means it comes first in the line

blocks.note: he is a male pronoun
Cuba is the largest Caribbean island

explanation.surface: A man living on a Caribbean island is the celebrated consort of a monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Hecuba was the queen of Troy and wife of King Priam in Homer's Iliad.

clue.text: Man's head dropping for Egyptian dancer

indicators.note: the head falls lower, so the opening letter leaves the front and is set further down

blocks.note: a man is a male

explanation.surface: A man nods his head in favour of an Egyptian dancer.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry the first letter literally drops: it moves from the top to third place.
explanation.definitionFit: An alme or almah is an Egyptian dancing girl, a professional entertainer.

clue.text: Before entering, mostly put away music system

indicators.note: entering means going inside, so one word sits within another
mostly means all but the last letter is kept

blocks.note: to stow is to put away
ere is an old word for before

explanation.surface: Before coming in, mostly tidy away the hi-fi.
explanation.definitionFit: A stereo is a sound system that plays recorded music through two speakers.

clue.text: In New Orleans you all shout America's first — for eccentricity!

indicators.note: first points to the opening letter of the word before it
one thing standing for another means it replaces it

blocks.note: to yell is to shout
the first letter of America
e is the mathematical symbol for eccentricity

explanation.surface: A cry of 'America first!' from a New Orleans crowd, put down to eccentricity.
explanation.definitionFit: Y'all is the Southern US contraction of 'you all', the plural you heard in Louisiana.

clue.text: Who might capture romantic hearts of say, Jasmine, Letitia and Ingrid?

definitions.text: Who might capture romantic hearts of say, Jasmine, Letitia and Ingrid?

indicators.note: the heart of a word is its central letters
romantic means fanciful and unreal, so the letters are freely rearranged

blocks.note: the middle letter of say
the central three letters of Jasmine
the central three letters of Letitia
the central two letters of Ingrid

explanation.surface: Who could win the affections of three women at once?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Say' looks like 'for example', but it supplies a letter too; the whole clue doubles as the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A trigamist is someone married to three spouses at once, exactly a man who wins three brides.

clue.text: Fixer used in photography? Possibly

indicators.note: used in says the letters lie inside the following words

blocks.note: the letters straddling the two words

explanation.surface: A question about a chemical used in developing photographs.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface is literally true, which makes the hidden word easy to overlook.
explanation.definitionFit: Hypo is the common name for sodium thiosulphate, the chemical that fixes a photographic image.

clue.text: Personal Trainer secures missing chlorine for prolapses

indicators.note: missing means lacking, so these letters are taken out

blocks.note: PT is the usual short form of personal trainer
to secure a door is to close it
Cl is the chemical symbol for chlorine

explanation.surface: A fitness coach handles a client's slipped organs, without the pool chemicals.
explanation.definitionFit: Ptosis is a drooping or sinking of a body part, especially the eyelid, so its plural means prolapses.
